findings.text: The company has the status 'administration' and an insolvency case on record where administration started on 12 December 2025.
Accounts are overdue with the next due date being 30 December 2025, and the last accounts were made up to 30 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is overdue with the next due date being 5 June 2026, and the last statement was made up to 22 May 2025.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company, alongside 0 part-satisfied and 2 satisfied charges.

Two persons with significant control are recorded: F. BLACK, who is a convicted criminal with ownership of shares 25 to 50 percent, voting rights 25 to 50 percent, and the right to appoint and remove directors; and PERSON 327, who has significant influence or control.
The two current directors have 11 other appointments across 11 other companies, including 7 active, 3 dissolved, and 1 in administration.
One registered office address change was filed on 29 December 2025, and there have been no officer appointments or resignations since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 441 is in administration with overdue accounts and confirmation statements, and has two persons with significant control.
